'''December 2000 Parker tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Parker, CO on 2 December 2000. [[Brian Hunter]] won it. It is known from Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1517">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-07-parker-co-12-2-00-somebody-call-my-mamad1517/ parker-co-12-2-00-somebody-call-my-mama], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 7 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-07-parker-co-12-2-00-somebody-call-my-mamad1517/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 2 December 2000
* '''Site:''' Parker, CO
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Hunter]]
